ratchet._comment_aggregate_tolerance: total-hot-surfaces (the aggregate ratchet row) is gated at this strictly tighter tolerance than tolerance_pct. If it used the same tolerance_pct as per-row checks, growth spread evenly across every per-row surface (each individually still within tolerance_pct) would also land inside tolerance_pct in aggregate, defeating the point of an aggregate check.

ratchet._comment_slice_b_final_wave: Final wave: the '### Always Load' table previously listed 4 references/*.md files (terminology.md, case-library/INDEX.md, module-codes.md, techniques/heuristics.md) that all resolved to the 103KB runtime-foundation.md bundle, dragging the whole bundle hot on every substantive case (always-load-bundles floor = 214005 bytes / 53501 est_tok). Those 4 files' load-bearing content is now authored as compact in-kernel digests inside atomics/skill/SKILL.md ('### Always-Load Digests (kernel)', ~15.5KB), and the Always Load table carries 0 references/*.md rows -- the full files remain available on demand, compiled cold in runtime-foundation.md. This is LICENSED growth on skill-md-only (+16010 bytes / +4002 est_tok: 110797->126807 bytes, 27699->31701 est_tok) for a much larger floor win: always-load-bundles drops from 53501 to 31701 est_tok (-21800 est_tok), because it is now == skill-md-only (0 bundles resolve). five-bundle-substantive and total-hot-surfaces necessarily grow by the same root delta (they sum skill-md-only + all 5 bundles, and per-bundle rows are untouched): 1098840->1114850 bytes, 274710->278712 est_tok (+16010 bytes / +4002 est_tok). structural-diagnosis-floor also drops because it is always-load-bundles (now == root) + the Mandatory Diagnostic Core bundle, which is untouched: 336751->249553 bytes, 84187->62388 est_tok. Net: +4002 est_tok root growth buys -21800 est_tok floor reduction. Root stays under the 130000-byte / ~32500-est_tok ceiling (126807 bytes / 31701 est_tok, margin 3193 bytes). Note: this also required raising two independent hard-coded 80,000-char control-plane size ceilings on atomics/skill/SKILL.md (tools/check_metacompliance_current_canon.py ROOT_MAX_CHARS and tools/check_recursion_collapse_noetic_frame.py's inline 80_000 check) to 96,000 -- the atomics source file itself grew from 79,979 to 95,420 chars carrying the digest prose (a larger delta than the compiled/byte view above because the atomics source has no bundle-substitution accounting).

_comment_exclusions: largest-retained-output is intentionally excluded from ratchet.baseline: it measures the size of a retained proof-corpus case output, and it is legal (and expected over time) for retained outputs to grow large as cases accumulate more traversal detail. Gating on it would penalize correct, larger-but-valid outputs, so this row is measured for visibility only and is never enforced by the ratchet.
